jobs.description: For a leading international logistics company in Eindhoven, we are looking for a motivated Dispatcher. In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating transport movements, communicating with drivers, and supporting daily logistics operations. You will start with a comprehensive training period and have the opportunity to progress into different shifts and responsibilities within the dispatch department. Wie zoeken we? We are looking for someone who: Has excellent communication skills. Speaks fluent English and has a basic command of Dutch. Can work accurately in a fast-paced environment. Has strong organizational and planning skills. Enjoys working as part of a team. Is proactive and takes responsibility for their work. Has an interest in logistics and transportation. Previous experience in dispatching or logistics is an advantage but not required. Wat bieden wij je? What We Offer Starting salary of €17.45 gross per hour. Travel allowance (reiskostenvergoeding) in accordance with company regulations. A challenging position within an international logistics environment. Comprehensive onboarding and training program. Opportunities for professional growth and progression within the dispatch team. Functieomschrijving During the initial training period, you will work the 15:00 - 00:00 shift, where your primary responsibility will be the registration and coordination of incoming and outgoing trucks entering and leaving the site. After successfully completing your training, your responsibilities will expand to include: Receiving and handing over CMR documents to drivers. Coordinating with warehouse operations regarding loaded containers and trailers. Monitoring transport schedules and ensuring operational efficiency. Identifying capacity shortages and arranging additional transportation when necessary. Maintaining close communication with drivers, warehouse staff, fellow dispatchers, and management. Ensuring smooth and efficient logistics processes throughout theoperation. Working Hours This is a 24/7 operation with the following rotating shifts: 06:00 - 15:00 15:00 - 00:00 19:00 - 05:00 00:00 - 09:00 21:00 - 06:00 The operational week runs from Sunday 00:00 until Saturday 09:00.

- Den Hoorn -  €15,29 per uur - Logistiek - 36 uur Do you want to work as an HLO (Man Up) Orderpicker at the large logistics company Van der Helm? The job is done with a tall Combi Truck. The worker sits inside the cabin of the machine. The cabin is big enough, so the worker has space to sit and move safely. The machine can go very high, up to 12-16 meters.
